significance: Through N, the number of indices n ≥ 5 at which the arctangent-sum tangent is an integer is O((log N)^(3/4)).
prior_work: Amdeberhan, Medina and Moll posed the all-index conjecture. Ken Ono established the logarithmic counting bound. The arithmetic height reduction has earlier public work in open-math-agents. The claim here is the three-quarters exponent; priority beyond this comparison is undetermined.
